I had a wonderful experience at PC Chandra Jewellers, Ultadanga, thanks to the exceptional assistance of Rimpa. She was incredibly patient, knowledgeable, and truly dedicated to helping me find the perfect gold chain that matched my personal style. Her keen eye for detail and honest suggestions made the entire selection process smooth and enjoyable. Rimpa took the time to understand what I was looking for and ensured that I walked away with something that not only looked great but felt just right for me.

Her professionalism, warmth, and genuine interest in customer satisfaction made a lasting impression. I highly recommend asking for Rimpa if you’re visiting this showroom—she’s a true gem!

Bought these two items last night for me and my daughter. PULAK was really helpful he cared for all that I wished for.
Also, the best gesture was since I have an infant and maneuvering is a hustle for us with the baby.
He made sure that we don’t have to visit the other showroom for our daughter’s bangle. He rushed and brought all the options there very for little girls.
Really liked this gesture!
Need more people like him.

Overall, pc gold items can never go wrong, we are loyal customers for more than a decade now.

Very much satisfied about collection and staff behavior especially Mr. Pulak Chakraborty and Rakhi di... He is very helpful and have so much patience that he didn't give up easily untill we felt satisfied. Thank you so much P C Chandra for made our day so special. 😇🙏

I had an excellent experience purchasing a silver necklace from P C Chandra Jewellers, Ultadanga. The design is beautiful, and the quality is outstanding. Special thanks to salesperson Priyadarshini Dutta for her professional and courteous service. Highly satisfied!

From P C Chandra we buy so many ornaments, here brother Shantanu  and brother Shushavan helped us very much, there behaviour also very good, they are so much entertained us and very much helpful to us.Thank you PC Chandra,you have kept so sincere staffs.
Good experience over all, good behaviour.. thanks a ton Priyadarshini Dutta. (Ultadanga P.C.. Chandra)
